mechanism_support_definition: A row is conditionally supported only when the paired held-out-seed 90% interval has boundary enrichment > 1 and positive boundary-minus-nonboundary D_adj; the surface-wide flag requires all 72 prespecified rows to pass. This is descriptive, not a new release gate or simultaneous claim test.

surface.semantics: three unordered context pairs x two directions x three frozen metrics; each row is repeated at four top-k budgets

fixed_data_protocol.crossfit: fit on one source-only 15-seed half with both measurement replicates; evaluate on the disjoint 15-seed half; repeat after swapping halves
fixed_data_protocol.top_k_rule: max(1, floor(budget_fraction*n_items)); lowest source risk; ties by fixed label order
fixed_data_protocol.label_order: lexicographic perturbation_label order, matching the existing fixed decision-table construction

estimands.global_d_adj: canonical per-seed U-corrected pairwise order disagreement on all unordered pairs
estimands.boundary_pair_set: all unordered pairs with exactly one item in the source-only top-k shortlist
estimands.boundary_d_adj: mean per-pair U-corrected D_adj over source-selected versus source-outside pairs, evaluated on held-out source/target seeds
estimands.nonboundary_d_adj: mean per-pair U-corrected D_adj over the complement of the frozen boundary pair set
estimands.boundary_enrichment: boundary_d_adj/global_d_adj; equivalently boundary D_adj contribution share divided by boundary pair share
estimands.boundary_to_nonboundary_ratio: boundary_d_adj/nonboundary_d_adj, retained as a separate ratio
estimands.deterministic_boundary_inversion: strict target-risk inversions among selected-versus-outside pairs, with ties within the fixed tolerance not counted
estimands.shortlist_retention: fraction of the target top-k oracle retained by the frozen source shortlist
estimands.normalized_regret: (target mean risk of frozen shortlist - target oracle mean risk)/(target all-item mean risk - target oracle mean risk)
estimands.mis_selection_fraction: source-shortlist items absent from the target oracle divided by k

target_outcomes_used_only_for: held-out target order states in D_adj

uncertainty.global_d_adj_intervals: copied from the existing canonical full-depth matched-fixed summary; no new global estimand
uncertainty.boundary_and_decision_intervals: paired 30-seed q05/q95 bootstrap, conditional on each cross-fit source shortlist; both split assignments contribute one held-out record per seed
uncertainty.selection_uncertainty: not included in the conditional intervals; the source shortlist is intentionally frozen within each cross-fit split
